Subject: Delta Analytics onboarding cadence — timezone-bridge session proposal

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our notes, it sounds like a two-part onboarding will work best: a 60–75 minute Console walkthrough (overview, RBAC, dashboards, runbook) followed by a focused API enablement lab (credentials, sample integration, KV cache tips) for the devs.

Because your team spans North America and EMEA, I wanted to propose a single "timezone-bridge" slot that captures the core audience rather than two separate sessions. Two options we can run next week:

1) Tue May 13 — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CET (90 minutes)
2) Thu May 15 — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 CET (90 minutes)

I'll bring a short preflight checklist and a slide deck; Ben (cc'd) will host the hands-on portion if we split facilitation. Can you let me know which of these works for you and whether Rajiv needs to be on the console walkthrough or only the API lab?

Attachments: Delta-Onboarding-Agenda.pdf (draft), Access-Checklist.xlsx (credentials matrix)

If neither works, we can carve the onboarding into a short Executive overview + deep-dive lab on different days — happy to be flexible.

Best,
